beats.summary: In the crypt, Bonogo finds a large, beautiful family crypt. He pries open the door, triggering a flash of runes, but nothing else happens—the ring from the box under the master bed disabled the traps. He opens sarcophaguses: one holds a skeleton, another a skeleton and an iron amulet, a child-sized one is empty, and two others resist his strength, prompting a pulley plan. Back in the master bedroom, Ephanna finds a beautiful envelope addressed to Bonogo, opens it with Mage Hand, and reads a scrawling message ending 'I'll keep watching.' She replaces it. In the children’s room, they find old clothes, a locked chest, and strange symbols on the windows. Unable to decipher them, they copy the symbols and pick the chest lock, finding old toys and a scratched orb with constellations. Caelynn cannot identify the symbols either, though they appear close to Infernal.

The final sarcophagus holds two copper rings and a faded stone tablet. He then unlocks the safe, finding 40 silver, a broken compass, and a key shaped like a wolf, and reads the letter on the bed.

beats.title: Hidden Trap Door and Summoning Room
beats.summary: During a final kitchen check before leaving, Ephanna notices an old worn handle that no one can move. Remembering Bonogo's wolf-head key, they use it; with a click the handle moves, revealing a trap door to the basement. Below, a collapsed wall opens into another room covered in strange symbols with a floor painted as a summoning circle—the same circle used by the Necromancer. Stafl then Ephanna smell cooked meat. Karsemine finds constellations matching those upstairs and on Ephanna's orb. Caelynn studies the ring, determines how it works, and believes she can operate it. Despite a tunnel heading toward the city, they lock the room and return to the Academy.

beats.title: Academy Return and Blizzy's Potion Dispute
beats.summary: Back at the Academy the group speaks with Torbin, and Caelynn finds someone to check her mushrooms. They hear an upset goblin arguing about payment for an order—Blizzy arguing with Winna over payment for a huge potion order. Stafl's Suggestion on Winna fails to convince her to pay; they must request payment from Headmaster Tinkerbright. Stafl then persuades Blizzy that all will be handled and she can leave the cart of potions with him.
